correctness.rationale: TARGET proof verified: re-executed verify_forcing.py (ALL CHECKS PASSED). 10 forced primal bonds distinct (6 open + 4 closed); N/S 3-bond primal paths trace (0,1)->(0,4) and (0,-1)->(0,-4) inside Ann(1,4); W/E dual paths with bond-by-bond crossing correspondence trace 0.5-adjacent inner->outer; supports disjoint and N/E/S/W alternating. P(F)=2^-10 by independence at p=1/2; FKG wording is harmless. Chain P(A(1,4))>=2^-10>=2^-10*P(A(1,2))*P(A(2,4)) valid since factors in [0,1]. Rigorous proof, not Monte Carlo.

originality.rationale: Literal dyadic instance P(A(1,4))>=2^-10*P(A(1,2))*P(A(2,4)) at 1-2-4 with constant 2^-10 is not recorded verbatim in fused 20 results and not implied by nearest general quasi-multiplicativity theorems, which state existence of unspecified C1,C2 for general scales (often large R/r) and do not entail this exact fixed-scale constant. Full-text inspection of the two most dangerous primaries confirms absence of this exact claim. Narrow novelty only; timestamp alone was not used.

value.rationale: ADMISSION_DEFECT: admitted TARGET is a vacuous arbitrary-parameter fact. The proof uses no RSW input beyond p=1/2 symmetry: any fixed 10-bond pattern has probability 2^-10, and the relative inequality follows solely from product factors <=1, so the stronger absolute bound P(A(1,4))>=2^-10 makes the quasi-multiplicativity form vacuous. Exhibiting straight corridors at fixed scale 1-2-4 is a textbook positivity exercise, teaches nothing about separation/gluing across scales, and has no demonstrated downstream need. Certification does not create value. Intrinsic low value requires REJECT.
